component: Integrate worker-bound capacity health with version-2 role receipts

red.reason: health worker-store observation rejects version-2 startup receipt

live_diagnostic.meaning: expected alert status, not command failure

capacity_finding.detail: 5 active autoship workflow(s) have a durable resource-capacity wait. A running worker or recent manual merge does not clear this blocker.
capacity_finding.fix: Inspect `augmentagent autopr readiness --json` using the worker's selected policy and delegated resource context. Restore supported capacity or complete verified ownership recovery; never delete unknown sessions or reset reservations.

assertions: Health reads confirmed merge allowance and durable capacity waits from the actual running worker configuration/store, without creating a missing fallback database or using the observer environment as worker authority.
Active durable capacity waits produce an ALERT, including waits whose retry time is in the future. Held/terminal/owner-paused workflows are excluded; resume restores a still-present capacity alert.

Worker store configuration accepts actual supported integer receipt versions 1 and 2. Other versions/types, stale process identity, changed/private-invalid receipt, unexpected configuration fields and ambiguous version-1 HOME/store resolution refuse.

The merged script retains both owner-identity and workflow-store modes. Descriptive health compatibility does not weaken the separate version-2 managed owner admission or original policy/configuration/runtime fences.

The integrated binary reads the current worker facts and reports five active capacity-blocked workflows that the deployed binary omitted. This is diagnostic readback only, not activation or deployed acceptance.
Existing health rules, role/receipt identity tests, bounded helper timeout/reaping, worker-store resolution, native-capacity backoff/wake and owner pause exclusions pass.
limits: Component PR #1908 had green hosted checks at 2515dfdd before this merge. The merged source and compatibility correction still require fresh current-head hosted verification and exact-head independent review.
The health command collects diagnostic/disk observations. No notifications, policy changes, session removal, reservation/model-charge/allowance resets or daemon restart were performed.

Capacity counts and visible inventory are observations, not an original resource-closure or custody-credit capability. Eight retained sessions remain charged under the selected 8 GiB ceiling; the separate 16 GiB proposal awaits explicit owner decision.
This does not implement full native/source/resource/input/legacy qualification, productive successor/coding/continuation or the full Discord follow-up lifecycle.
Normal updater rollout, positive managed-worker authorization, live CLI/private Discord acceptance/updates, five real autonomous merges, 72-hour fault and 24-hour unattended soak remain unproven.
